closingSelfCheck.summary: CHK-001/002/003 core promises are delivered and independently re-verified (rebuilt from source, smoke binary green, 8 distinct review findings each have dedicated regression coverage). However, plan.md Risk notes overstates completeness: it claims exactly one accepted false-negative residual (fenced-code-block prose) with all other residuals false-positive-direction, but this reviewer reproduced a second, broader, undocumented false-negative bypass class live against the compiled HEAD code (hyphenated trigger word plus dot plus any non-excluded real file extension, e.g. deferred-query.sql, partial-config.json, silently erased, zero gaps) with zero smoke coverage. This is natural DONE-summary prose, not contrived adversarial input, and defeats the exact guard (unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage) this story exists to protect -- the same class of problem as F-004/F-005 but for unambiguous rather than ambiguous extensions. Recommend a follow-up finding/fix before treating the sanitizer's adversarial-safety claim as fully closed.
